description: Allowed import directions between the folders of src/ (stories #42, #55). A folder is the first directory under src/, or the first two under the areas in `twoLevelAreas`. Checked by test/tooling/dependencyDirection.test.cjs; `node test/tooling/folderDependencies.cjs` prints the measured matrix. When files move, rewrite this file, not the test.
layersNote: Top to bottom: a folder may import its own layer or a lower one, never a higher one, and a feature never imports another feature. Folders outside these areas (the pre-#55 tree, `(root)`) are not ranked. Each exception needs a reason.

twoWayPairs.active_servers<->servers: Until #55 B10 the running-server tree actions (active_servers) and the server views (servers) sit in two feature-like folders that call each other: serverOpenActions renders the preview through servers/runtime/previewRenderer.ts, and the launch toasts (servers/views/interactions/launchNotifications.ts) open a server through serverOpenActions. B10 puts previewRenderer, serverOpenActions and launchNotifications together in features/active-servers, which removes the pair.
twoWayPairs.code_analysis<->core/server: The analysis<->server pair of docs/cleanup/src-layout.md §3.5. The analysis bridges are hosted by the HTTP server (core/server/analysis/* -> code_analysis historical, dependencies, refresh, watchers) and stopping a server closes its analysis session (core/server/serverControl.ts -> sessionRegistry); the analysis engine launches and notifies servers (serverLaunchOrchestrator, SSE) and its watchers follow server removal (serverWatcherIntegration -> the registry and ServerControl). Inverting it means registering the bridges from the analysis side and an event or callback seam for the session (#13).
twoWayPairs.core/remote-access<->core/server: The servers authorize remote requests with RemoteSessionAuthority and the remote-access model (core/server -> core/remote-access), and RemoteAccessManager watches the running-server registry to stop a tunnel when its server goes and reads and turns off the cross-network setting through ServerSettingsManager (core/remote-access -> core/server). Breaking it needs that setting and the registry events behind an injected accessor (#13).
twoWayPairs.core/server<->servers: The one upward edge of src-layout.md §3.5 seen from both sides: core/server/multiServerLauncher.ts shows the post-launch toasts from servers/views/interactions/launchNotifications.ts (#42 item 5 / #39), while the servers feature drives the launcher and the server settings. After B10 the toasts are in features/active-servers and the edge is a reasoned layerExceptions entry.

vscodeFreeNote: src files from which no import path reaches `vscode` (type imports included). 97 when #42 started; may only go up. Raise the floor when it does. #55 batch 0 lowered it 109 -> 106 only because three vscode-free re-export barrels were deleted (configuration/models, customComponents, refresh index.ts); no surviving file lost the property.
